results.label: urgent
results.text: Hull integrity is falling, Captain. Stop demonstrating the docking clamps with the rest of the ship.

results.label: briefing
results.text: Captain, the route is ready. We have enough fuel for the next three jumps, and the destination station accepts our landing pad size. Finish the current scan before we depart. Once we arrive, I suggest refueling, repairing the hull, and checking the passenger lounge for a return contract. We are trying to earn a quiet living, after all. Shooting the docking clamps would make that considerably less quiet. I have marked the station in our navigation plan and will keep an eye on fuel consumption along the way.
